verdict.line: You lose if you let Yorick grind the lane into a slow burn where his sustain and walkers pile up; you win if you force extended trades and all-ins where your solo-kill power and W shield take over.

brief.thesis: This sits at 48.9% over 88 games with the lane graded EVEN but the solo-kill edge on your side — it's not a stat-check, it's a trade-length check. Your W (Indestructible) shield grows off damage dealt AND taken, so you want fights to run long; Yorick's Q (Last Rites) heal and grave-fed walker swarm want the opposite. Whoever decides how long the trade lasts wins it.

tell.watch: Yorick's Q cooldown and grave count

theirWindow.when: after his E (Mourning Mist) marks you
theirWindow.what: Mourning Mist reduces your armor, damages and slows you, and any walkers he has summoned gain move speed closing on a marked target. Back off behind minions immediately rather than trading through the mark.

yourWindow.when: the instant E (Death's Grasp) pulls him in
yourWindow.what: Death's Grasp drags every enemy in the area to you — follow it with Q (Obliterate) and autos to stack your 3-hit passive (Darkness Rise) for the damage aura and move speed, then let W (Indestructible) bank the shield off both the damage you land and the damage you eat.

powerCurve.note: both sides still setting up trades
Q cooldown drops fast, E online
his W wall and R online

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Run at 53.2% win rate over 94 games and 74.6% pick — the mana and sustain let you throw out Q/E on cooldown through the early trades instead of going dry.

boots.why: 51.2% win rate, 74.1% pick — flattens the physical damage from his empowered Q auto and his basic attacks, which is most of what actually hurts you in lane.

core.why: First piece of the 85.7%-win-rate path (small sample, 7 games) — the slow from your Q/E lets you keep landing the extra hits that feed W's shield.
Second item on both listed Rylai's paths — omnivamp and the ramping damage reward exactly the long trades W wants.
Closes out the highest win-rate path (85.7% over 7 games) — burn damage keeps compounding the longer the fight runs.

situational.when: yorick is building into a physical/attack-speed heavy setup
you want to cut his Q self-heal early and match OP.GG's own call to pressure him before his walkers stack up
you need the extra ability haste to loop Q/E faster in extended skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: Both common rune pages run Conqueror because it ramps on sustained trades — exactly the fight length your W shield and Riftmaker omnivamp want, and it keeps paying off the longer he can't kill you.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the highest win rate (53.3%) and by far the most picked (73.6%) — Ignite converts your solo-kill advantage into actual kills in the early all-ins and cuts into his Q self-heal.

playing.title: Trade while your passive is stacked
playing.detail: Darkness Rise needs 3 landed attacks or spells on him — look for the aura and move speed window before committing to your biggest trades.

playing.title: Pull him off his grave setup
playing.detail: Use E (Death's Grasp) to yank him out of the minion wave before his Q empowered auto resets, denying him the clean dig.

playing.title: Respect his wall timer
playing.detail: Dark Procession is on 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown — don't overextend right after he drops it, since it can block your retreat or trap you in with him.

playing.title: Bank W, don't panic-heal it
playing.detail: Indestructible's shield grows off damage you deal and take — let it build through the trade and only pop the heal once the exchange is actually over.

playing.title: Disengage off the Mourning Mist mark
playing.detail: Once E lands on you his summoned walkers gain speed chasing the mark — step behind minions rather than trading through it.

playing.title: All-in in the 3-5 window
playing.detail: Your Q cooldown is already down to 6s by level 3 and E is live — this is your strongest forcing window before his kit catches up.

playing.title: Stretch fights once Rylai's/Riftmaker land
playing.detail: From level 12 on, slow him with Q/E and just keep trading — the longer it runs, the more your core items and W shield outvalue his sustain.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners and the win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the tells, timing windows, and trade-length framing are my own read on the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Pressure Yorick during early game to gain lane control. Purchase Bramble Vest and maintain your [P] when fighting him.
